make -C {src} install TOAST= TCAT= UNTOAST= TOAST= GSM_INSTALL_ROOT={prefix} GSM_INSTALL_INC={prefix}/include GSM_INSTALL_LIB={prefix}/lib

mkdir -p {prefix}/lib/pkgconfig && printf 'prefix={prefix}
libdir={prefix}/lib

mingw-x86_64-llvm.prefixup: grep -rl 'soname' {src}/Makefile {src}/build/*.mk 2>/dev/null | xargs -r sed -i -e 's/-Xlinker -soname -Xlinker [^ ]*//g' -e 's/-Wl,-soname,[^ ]*//g' && sed -i 's/-f elf64/-f win64/g; s/-f elf /-f win64/g; s/-f elf$/-f win64/g' {src}/build/platform-gnu-chain.mk

libcaca.prefixup: sed -i 's/^#if defined _WIN32 && defined __GNUC__ && __GNUC__ >= 3/#if 0/' {src}/caca/string.c {src}/caca/figfont.c && sed -i 's/^bin_PROGRAMS =.*/bin_PROGRAMS =/' {src}/src/Makefile.am && sed -i 's/^bin_PROGRAMS =.*/bin_PROGRAMS =/; s/^noinst_PROGRAMS =.*/noinst_PROGRAMS =/' {src}/examples/Makefile.am

steps: cd {src}/build/linux && AS={tools}/bin/nasm CC=x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc CXX=x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++ ./configure --host=x86_64-w64-mingw32 --prefix={prefix} --extra-cflags="-fPIC -Wno-error=incompatible-function-pointer-types" && make -j{jobs} && make install
cd {src}/build/linux && CC=x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc CXX=x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++ ./configure --host=x86_64-w64-mingw32 --prefix={prefix} --extra-cflags=-fPIC && make -j{jobs} && make install

mingw-x86_64-llvm.prefixup:
sed -i 's/^#define const$/#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#endif
#define const/' {src}/tools/find_sts_main.c && sed -i 's/^__inline int c99_/static __inline int c99_/' {src}/include/cst_file.h && sed -i 's/^inline /static inline /; s/^__inline /static __inline /' {src}/include/*.h && sed -i 's/^__inline int ts_utf8_sequence_length/int ts_utf8_sequence_length/' {src}/src/utils/cst_tokenstream.c && sed -i 's/static __inline int ts_utf8_sequence_length(char c0);/int ts_utf8_sequence_length(char c0);/' {src}/include/cst_tokenstream.h
steps: cd {src} && mkdir -p {prefix}/include/flite {prefix}/lib && cp -f include/*.h {prefix}/include/flite/ && cp -f build/x86_64-mingw32/lib/*.a {prefix}/lib/

mkdir -p {prefix}/lib/pkgconfig && printf 'prefix={prefix}

cd {src} && PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_TARGET_X86_64_PC_WINDOWS_GNU_LINKER=x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc $HOME/.cargo/bin/cargo rustc --lib --release --features capi --crate-type cdylib --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu --quiet
